course_outline_concepts: Baize (Xu 2023): ChatGPT self-chat from seed topic; exact turn-count distribution
UltraChat construction: three-sector taxonomy + two-model dialogue
SODA + Prosocial-Dialog (Yejin Choi group): commonsense-grounded + safety-focused
OpenAssistant tree as a real-human baseline for evaluating synthetic conversation quality

sources.what_to_extract: Self-chat primitive: one LLM plays both User and AI via alternating role tags; 100K-111.5K dialogues from Quora/StackOverflow/Alpaca/MedQuAD seeds; LoRA fine-tune on LLaMA-7B/13B/30B; Self-Distill with Feedback (SDF) extension; homogeneity and user-realism gaps.

Exact prompt template with [|Human|] / [|AI|] markers; 111.5K seeds split (Quora 54K + StackOverflow 57K + Alpaca 52K + MedQuAD 47K); median turn count 4, tail to 10; avg ~100 tokens per turn; ~$1,000 API cost; single-call protocol with turn cap ~8.

Three-sector taxonomy (Questions-about-World / Writing-and-Creation / Assistance-on-Existing-Materials); two separate Turbo API calls for user and assistant; topic taxonomy replaces seeds; 30 meta-topics × 1100+ subtopics; 10K Wikidata entities; 20 writing types; ~100K C4 passages; dialogues 3-7 rounds (Q-world) or 2-4 (writing, assistance); ~1.5M total.

Two-model role-play generation loop; sector-specific prompt scaffolds; recursive conditioning on dialogue history for follow-ups; list-of-utterances data shape; preview lengths 4-14 turns; generation-protocol clarity vs. filter-heuristic opacity; taxonomy-first synthetic-data design.

Inception Prompting template verbatim: 'Never forget you are a <user-role> and I am a <assistant-role>... Give me one instruction at a time... When the task is solved, say <CAMEL_TASK_DONE>'; 50 assistant roles × 50 user roles × 20 domains; median turn count 6-8, tail to 20; task-completion-termination protocol; AI Society ~1M; cost ~$5-10K.

Commonsense-triple → narrative → dialogue pipeline; Atomic 10X triples (PersonX, relation, mental-state); 1.5M dialogues; median 7-8 turns, max ~12; avg 20 tokens per turn; PersonX/PersonY two-speaker protocol; emotional-grounding advantage over topic-prompted synthesis; COSMO-3B outcome; Yejin Choi lineage.

58K dialogues anchored to 300+ rules-of-thumb (RoTs); human-in-the-loop pipeline (not pure synthetic); 10 harm categories; median 3 turns; engage-and-redirect vs. pure refusal; CANARY model engages 89% of problematic prompts; precursor to Constitutional AI; Yejin Choi safety branch.

Tree-structured crowdsourced dialogue; prompter/assistant/labeler/ranker roles; 161K OASST1 messages across 10K trees in 35 languages; avg path 4-6 turns, tail 20+; branching replies with quality ranking; CC-BY 4.0; reference real-human baseline for evaluating synthetic corpora.

System-prompt diversity as first-class axis beyond topic/role diversity; Persona-Hub 1B personas; SystemChat-2.0 7K dialogues; 2× unique vocabulary and 3× persona-consistent-follow-up-rate vs. topic-only; integrated into Tülu-3, Qwen 2.5; how this generation extends UltraChat's taxonomy move.

~1M real user-ChatGPT logs via opt-in; realism anchor distinct from crowdsourced OASST; reveals distribution gap vs. synthetic dialogue (user-turn brevity, typos, jailbreak patterns); used in Tülu-3 mix as anchor.

Amplify-Instruct — seed composition from multiple prior synthetic datasets (Airoboros, Evol-Instruct, Orca, Vicuna, LessWrong); ~20K compact multi-turn mix; quality-over-scale design; used on Mistral-7B and Yi-34B.

SmolTalk 1M SFT mix composition; Magpie-Ultra 400K anchor + Smol-constraints/rewrite/summarize + SystemChats-2.0 30K; how modern production mixes blend synthetic-dialogue sub-mixes with targeted capability slices.
